A separate lay family of Harim also returned from Babylon (Ezra 2:32; Neh 7:35), with members likewise involved in the intermarriage crisis (Ezra 10:31). A Harim sealed the covenant under Nehemiah (Neh 10:5, 27). Spanish 'Harim' and English 'Harim' transliterate uniformly."
